code_isa: ARM (entry addresses even, no Thumb bit)
calling_convention: stock method: r0 this, r1 draw ctx, r2 image descriptor; returns 0x528 like stock; called through the vtable
vfp: s0-s3 / q0 only (d0-d1), same as stock; d16-d31 never touched
stack: method 16+0x528 (= stock); sample 40 (stock 24); draw 36+2320 (stock 28+0x408); sp parity at every callee equals stock
context: DrawMgr task. Not interrupt-safe; not needed.
assumption: thresholds [this+0x34..0x70] do not change while one frame is drawn (level is memoised per call; stock re-reads them per plot)
unpatch: write each stock value back; leave the code block allocated until power-off
